title: Repeat speculations by the same speaker
note: One speculation per speaker counts in the archive: the one with the widest scope of change, ties to the earliest. The others are kept here, out of every count and reading.

speculations.text: The moving picture art will largely supplement the art of printing.
speculations.speaker: Inventor
speculations.source: Frank Parker Hulette, interview with Thomas Edison, Moving Picture World, 22 July 1911, pp. 104–105. Compiled in “Thomas Edison’s Education Predictions”, muninn.net.

speculations.text: I believe that the motion picture is destined to revolutionize our educational system and that in a few years it will supplant largely, if not entirely, the use of textbooks.
speculations.speaker: Inventor
speculations.source: Hugh Weir, “The Story of the Motion Picture”, McClure’s 54, November 1922, p. 85; quoted in Cuban (1986).
speculations.verify: Full wording taken from secondary sources; check against McClure’s.

speculations.text: Textbooks as the principal medium of teaching will be as obsolete as the horse and carriage are now.
speculations.speaker: Inventor
speculations.source: Hugh Weir, “What Edison Would Like to Do with the Movies”, Collier’s 75, 21 February 1925, pp. 20–21. Compiled in muninn.net (as above).

speculations.text: If you just took the next 18 months, the AIs will come in as a teacher’s aide and give feedback on writing. … The AIs will get to that ability, to be as good a tutor as any human ever could.
speculations.speaker: Company
speculations.source: Bill Gates, ASU+GSV Summit, San Diego, April 2023; reported in CNBC, 22 April 2023.

speculations.text: A freestanding karaoke-style machine that lets kids use a mic to speak into to learn how words are spelt and pulled together.
speculations.speaker: Designer
speculations.note: Designed for Pakistan's many languages and the equation of English fluency with literacy. Retrieve: recitation and oral learning through a popular form. Status Existing: in 2020 Google's Bolo (Read Along), a speech-recognition reading tutor that listens to children read aloud, was available in Pakistan with Urdu stories; the kiosk form is a detail. First-pass coding by Claude from the ACM extension, to check.
speculations.source: Awais Hameed Khan, Neelam Ejaz, Sarah Matthews, Stephen Snow and Ben Matthews, “Speculative Design for Education: Using Participatory Methods to Map Design Challenges and Opportunities in Pakistan”, Proceedings of the 2021 ACM Designing Interactive Systems Conference (DIS ’21), 1748–1764. doi:10.1145/3461778.3462117

speculations.text: A drone based teaching delivery system that uses holographic projections of classes; flying to communities daily.
speculations.medium_wording: Drone Projections: holographic classes delivered by drone
speculations.speaker: Designer
speculations.note: Designed for regions where children travel long distances to school. Hologram coded as virtual reality, the nearest medium in the list. First-pass coding by Claude from the ACM extension, to check.
speculations.source: Awais Hameed Khan, Neelam Ejaz, Sarah Matthews, Stephen Snow and Ben Matthews, “Speculative Design for Education: Using Participatory Methods to Map Design Challenges and Opportunities in Pakistan”, Proceedings of the 2021 ACM Designing Interactive Systems Conference (DIS ’21), 1748–1764. doi:10.1145/3461778.3462117

speculations.who: A student at an all-girls school in New Delhi (Sebastian et al.)
speculations.text: Concentration in studies will increase... you gain confidence that you can do it.
speculations.speaker: Workshop participants
speculations.note: Made by participants in a workshop run by the authors; speaker Workshop participants. Spoken, so Academic paper. Group G3, the same group as record 39. Students reimagined lessons where they could 'see calculations in 360 degrees'. First-pass coding by Claude from the ACM extension, to check.
speculations.source: Priyanka Sebastian, Sumita Sharma, Netta Iivari, Marianne Kinnula, Aakash Gautam, Charu Monga, Deepanshu Verma, Chinmay Pade and Chandni Tandon, “‘Robots should not be used for household chores because that would make us lazy’: How Scaffolding Shapes Children’s Capacity to Imagine Educational Futures”, Proceedings of the 25th ACM Interaction Design and Children Conference (IDC ’26), 656–671. doi:10.1145/3773077.3806133

speculations.who: Eight education and game-design experts (Özkaya & Baykal)
speculations.text: By 2035, high school education in this vision is no longer organized around standard classes or single programs.
speculations.medium_wording: Game-like skill trees across a school network (2035 design-fiction news story)
speculations.speaker: Workshop participants
speculations.note: Made by participants in a workshop run by the authors; speaker Workshop participants. Learning follows 'a progression logic familiar from games'; coded Game. First-pass coding by Claude from the ACM extension, to check.
speculations.source: Mehmed Nihad Özkaya and Gökçe Elif Baykal, “Sustainable School Setting Futures: WorldBuilding and Mandala to Co-Speculate on Student Motivation in 2035”, Proceedings of the 25th ACM Interaction Design and Children Conference (IDC ’26), 896–901. doi:10.1145/3773077.3812164
